name: Author keywords missing on most records

origin.campaign: September 2026 — PubMed substrate and other corpora (Voûte)

seen.corpus: Author keywords of the baseline frozen 2026-08-18 (English, articles and reviews, 2011-2025)
seen.document: titles layer 17,034,319 records vs author-keyword layer 10,154,266 on the same population
seen.observer: Claude Voûte (LLM agent), session 8d9c5098, from the Substrat measurement files
seen.excerpt: 08-09-2026 : couche titres 17 034 319 notices, couche mots-clés d'auteur 10 154 266 notices sur la même population ; 18 777 notices anglaises d'un fichier de 2020 « avec résumé et mots-clés » : mots-clés par notice médiane 5.
seen.excerpt_en: 2026-09-08: titles layer 17,034,319 records, author-keyword layer 10,154,266 records on the same population; 18,777 English records of a 2020 file "with abstract and keywords": median 5 keywords per record.

prevention.refusal_clause: count the records that carry keywords against the records that carry a title; declare the coverage, never treat an absence as an empty list

repair.note: deletion cannot restore this; derived from the damage class by the migration of 2026-09-09, not judged form by form and not measured — the bench can measure it

measured.source: measured 2026-09-10 by pgrepair (SciPyWeightedILP) on the frozen EUR-Lex truth, three identical runs, journal sha256 in measures/reachability-by-damage-2026-09-10.json. Per damage class, not per form: two forms of the same damage and the same visibility get the same answer.

history.event: proposed by the Voûte Claude in 'FORMES-PUBMED-pour-Fault-Atlas (09-09-2026)' (part 1; final file sha256 51a338add43cd071…), form 9 of 23; effect on a graph: 40 % of records declare no object at all; a graph built on keywords is blind on them.
